noise_seed_formula: seed + 1009 * delay; Python random.Random.getrandbits(1), test fixture generation only
bit_panel: all eight A/B/R tuples for every condition, delay and noise sequence
memory_rule: door = A; B and R irrelevant and not visible at choice
logic_rule: door = A XOR B XOR R; all three operands visible only at choice
combined_rule: door = A XOR B XOR R; earlier clues absent at choice, R visible
action_policy: wait before choice; one door at choice; early, missing, invalid and timeout fail without retry
feedback: none during episode; Boolean reward after action only in training mode; no feedback in standard evaluation
delay_meaning: number of distractors after cue A; A-to-choice distance is delay+2 observations, B-to-choice distance is one
reset: new environment and reset policy per independent episode
checks: label balance conditional on current choice observation

expected_controls.current: logic 100%, memory and combined 50% on balanced complete panel

limitations: administrator fixture stream is not a learner API
type-level observation isolation is not a hostile-process security sandbox
Timeout is an explicit environment action; external wall-clock enforcement requires a future process adapter
bounded logical task is not general reasoning
handwritten exact solver success is not learned or connectomic success
